royal-violet.$description: Royal Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Icon strokes, secondary accents on violet backgrounds, chart highlights — a slightly lighter companion to Royal Violet

lemon-zest.$description: Lemon Zest — Top announcement banners, brand lemon accent, key highlight moments — a sharp citrus spike against the violet/white system

orchid.$description: Orchid — Decorative pastel accent on violet sections, soft highlight washes, pill badge fills

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Soft pastel background fills, subtle card highlights, eyebrow tag backgrounds

blush.$description: Blush — Pale wash backgrounds, secondary pastel accent

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Brand icon accents, chart data lines, secondary illustration color

emerald.$description: Emerald — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

magenta.$description: Magenta — Decorative accent, illustration color, highlight moments

crimson.$description: Crimson — Decorative accent, illustration color, highlight moments

ember.$description: Ember — Decorative accent, illustration color, warm highlight moments

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, dark filled buttons, nav text, headings — the near-black that carries all foreground content

paper.$description: Paper — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas, subtle section backgrounds, surface level beneath cards

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, secondary descriptions, nav links, helper copy

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, dividers, subtle separation lines

circularpro-book.$description: Display and heading family — used for all headlines from 18px sub-labels up to 80px hero display. Custom geometric sans with tight negative tracking creates a blocky, confident presence. The ss04 alternate set should be enabled for brand character.

inter.$description: Body and UI text — nav links at 15px, body copy at 16-18px, uppercase labels at 14px with wide tracking. The 0.143em letter-spacing at 14px signals the eyebrow/label style for section headers.
